tools.name: check_website_security
tools.description: AttackerView's quick website security check: reports problems with a domain's security headers, HTTP to HTTPS redirect, DNS, email authentication and TLS. Use when the user asks things like 'is example.com secure?' or 'are my security headers, SSL, SPF or DMARC set up right?'. Passive check in secon

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_website_security · Public sink: check_website_security.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_website_security · Public sink: check_website_security

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
